label: Diagram 3.16
caption: Diagram 3.16 Floor type 2 – external cavity wall with masonry internal leaf
description:
A section drawing, titled in a green band at the top "Diagram 3.16 Floor type 2 – external cavity wall with masonry internal leaf", with the word "SECTION" at the lower right corner.

On the left a vertical wall is shown in section, drawn as a diagonally hatched outer leaf and a cross‑hatched inner leaf separated by an air gap; it is labelled "External cavity wall" below. A horizontal floor build‑up projects to the right from this wall, made of stacked layers: a top dotted course, a middle course of small circles, a course of small rectangular blocks, and a lower hatched layer.

Leader lines carry the labels "Cavity stop", pointing to a block seated in the wall's gap, and "Fill small gap with flexible seal", pointing to the junction where the top of the floor meets the upper part of the wall. A vertical member running down through the floor is labelled "Timber batten". A horizontal dimension arrow between two vertical lines reads "Minimum 300mm", measuring the distance from the inner leaf of the wall to the timber batten.
